name: decoder_router_hier_topk_v1
hypothesis: Replace the fused route kernel's 256-element tl.topk with four independent 64-expert top-8 operations followed by an exact top-8 over the 32 candidates. Since the packed score includes expert-id tie-breaking and is unique per expert, hierarchical top-k preserves the exact chosen routes. This exploits the existing four-warp CTA without adding a launch.
upstream_inspiration: vLLM Muse Spark CUDA routing PR #64553 (merged Oct 30 2026); adapt only hierarchical warp-local top-k. Its redux.sync.max.f32 optimization is Blackwell-only and is not used on H200.
screen: paired exact-parent judge-image H200, sliding decode and verify batches 1/8/16/32, randomized order, at least 4 paired rounds after compile warmup
expected_component_ceiling: The fused route kernel is about 1.8-2.1 us in existing profiles; even a 50% route-kernel reduction bounds layer latency savings to roughly 0.4-1.0% depending on load, before critical-path overlap.
